annotations.title: Create or update a short link

description: Create or update a tracked short link (/l/<code>) for a post caption or Instagram DM auto-reply on Studio or Pro. Put the returned short address in a post or DM to count human clicks (crawlers and link previews still get the 302 redirect so preview cards render, without inflating click counts) and surface per-post clicks in Results.

active.description: true keeps the /l/<code> redirect live; false returns 404 without deleting click history. Defaults to true.

autoreplyRuleId.description: Optional Instagram auto-reply rule id from autoreplies_list to attribute DM link clicks. Pass null to unlink.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

draftId.description: Optional draft id from drafts_list to associate this short link with a post. Pass null to unlink.

id.description: An existing short link id from short_links_list to update. Leave out to create a new short link.

label.description: An optional short label for your own list and Results (up to 80 characters), for example "Spring menu". Pass null or empty string to clear.

postId.description: Optional published postId to associate this short link with a specific post. Pass null to unlink.

url.description: The destination https:// web address the short link redirects visitors to (required when creating a new short link).

name: short_links_save
title: Create or update a short link
